title: NON-RECORD SUBMISSION ----- Text_diffusion_MDLM
author: laox5

data.description: Uses grouped query attention with separate query heads and fewer key/value heads, expanding KV pairs to match Q dimensions before attention.
Uses rotary position embeddings in the attention mechanism.
Non-causal Transformer for masked diffusion language modeling with bidirectional attention and iterative denoising from fully masked sequences.
Additive time conditioning injected into the residual stream before RMSNorm in attention and MLP blocks.
CastedLinear layers keep weights in FP32 while casting inputs to BF16 under autocast for numerical stability.

novel_contributions: Masked diffusion language model (MDLM) training pipeline
RoPE with FlashAttention-style scaled dot product attention
